kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتحشرج (form IIq)
# نَتَحَشْرَجُ (nataḥašraju) /na.ta.ħaʃ.ra.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
# نَتَحَشْرَجَ (nataḥašraja) /na.ta.ħaʃ.ra.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
# نَتَحَشْرَجْ (nataḥašraj) /na.ta.ħaʃ.rad͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
